alt: A global logistics network hub: a mustard and slate freight terminal with a curved roof and three coloured roll-up doors, a round sorting platform with conveyor ramps like spokes, wooden crates and barrels, and a control tower block, on a paved square base plate

provenance.prompt: Isometric game building icon for a historical civilization strategy game: a global logistics network hub, a wide low freight terminal of mustard-yellow and slate-grey panels with a shallow curved roof, a row of loading bays with solid roll-up doors in three colours, a raised circular sorting platform in the centre with four solid conveyor ramps leading out like spokes, a small stack of plain unmarked wooden crates and barrels beside the bays, and a short solid control tower cube with narrow amber windows. One building on a small square base plate, three-quarter view from above and slightly right, centred and filling about 80% of a square image. Clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark ink outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette, readable at 40 pixels. Plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background, no ground scenery beyond the base plate, no shadows on the background. No flag, no banner, no ship, no crane, no truck, no aircraft, no lattice, no cables, no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no readable screens, no smoke, no watermark. Square 1:1 image.
